idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

args.summary: The latest production deploy (v2.3.1) failed health checks in all regions with an 18% error rate. First attempted rollback to v2.3.0 (previous healthy release) but it was rejected as quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417. Rolled back instead to v2.2.9 (next most recent healthy production release) in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback verified: service healthy, error rate down to 0.2%. Follow-ups: investigate root cause of v2.3.1 regression; do not redeploy v2.3.0 until CVE-2026-4417 quarantine is lifted.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.2.9

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api's latest deploy (v2.3.1) was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. **First rollback attempt**: Tried rolling back to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy release), but it was rejected — v2.3.0 is quarantined due to **CVE-2026-4417**.
3. **Completed rollback**: Rolled back to v2.2.9 (the next most recent healthy production release) in all regions.
4. **Verified**: checkout-api is now healthy across all regions, with error rate down from 18% to 0.2%.
5. **Incident opened**: SEV2 incident **INC-0001** filed for checkout-api, describing the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the CVE quarantine of v2.3.0, the successful v2.2.9 rollback, and follow-up items (root-cause v2.3.1; don't redeploy v2.3.0 until the CVE is resolved).
